intro:
Recruit Warriors.
Build Your Legion.
Survive Every Battle.
description:
Lead a small group of survivors and build the ultimate legion in a world where every battle makes your army stronger. Defeat enemies, recruit new warriors, and expand your forces as you fight to become the strongest commander on the battlefield.

*Build Your Legion
Start with only a handful of fighters and grow into an unstoppable army. Recruit survivors after every victory, strengthen your squad, and unlock powerful new units to dominate the battlefield.
*Survive Intense Battles
Face relentless waves of enemies and dangerous rival legions. Every encounter requires quick decisions, smart movement, and tactical positioning. Only the strongest commanders will survive.
*Customize Your Fighters
Unlock a variety of skins and visual upgrades to create a unique-looking legion. Personalize your army and stand out while leading your warriors into battle.

Build your army, survive against overwhelming odds, and become the legendary commander of Survival Legion.
